parcelEditDisabled: Edit is available for Created, Picked up, or Assigned parcels that are not linked.
parcelContactOnly: You can correct the order reference and customer contact details. Township, zone, and COD are locked for this parcel.
fieldHistoryLoadError: Parcel field history could not be loaded.
noFieldHistory: No parcel field changes have been recorded.

parcelUpdateError.MONEY_POSTED: This parcel has posted money entries. Finance must reverse them before it can be changed.
parcelUpdateError.ADVANCE_POSTED: COD, delivery fee, and township cannot be changed after the batch pickup advance is posted.
parcelUpdateError.PARCEL_NOT_EDITABLE: This parcel is read-only because only Created, Picked up, or Assigned parcels can be edited.
parcelUpdateError.PARCEL_LINKED: Unlink this parcel before editing its delivery details.

linkParcelsExplanation: Link {{count}} parcels and assign all of them to the responsible rider. The highest parcel fee becomes the base fee, plus 1,000 MMK per additional parcel.
unlinkParcelsExplanation: Financial entries already posted for this group will be reversed and recalculated as individual parcels.
parcelVoidEligibilityNote: Void entry is available for unassigned Created parcels. Delivered parcels need financial reconciliation before correction.
parcelVoidExplanation: Use this only when the OS never supplied this parcel. The entry and correction history remain visible. This does not record a physical return.
parcelVoidDraftImpact: This draft parcel will be excluded from the batch COD and parcel count before finalization.
parcelVoidFinalizedImpact: The server will reverse the COD currently attributed to this parcel when safe. Any advance, payment, or earlier amount already recorded must be reconciled separately in the OS account.
parcelVoidCurrentAmounts: Current fields: COD {{cod}} MMK · delivery fee {{fee}} MMK
parcelVoidBalancePreview: OS outstanding: {{before}} MMK → {{after}} MMK. Obligation reduction: {{reversed}} MMK.
parcelVoidCreditPreview: Advance paid: {{advance}} MMK · available OS credit: {{credit}} MMK. Voiding does not refund or reverse the advance.
parcelVoidPreviewError: Could not load the current OS balance. Refresh and try again before confirming.
parcelVoidZeroingAudit: Latest recorded zeroing changed COD from {{cod}} MMK and delivery fee from {{fee}} MMK (— means that field did not change in that edit). This edit history is not proof of a posted balance.
parcelVoidZeroWarning: If these fields were changed to zero, the displayed amounts do not show the original posted balance. Review the batch account and ledger after correction.
parcelVoidReasonValidation: Enter a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
parcelVoidSuccess: Parcel entry voided. COD reversed: {{reversed}} MMK. Remaining OS balance: {{remaining}} MMK. Review the account and ledger for earlier amounts, advances, or payments.
parcelVoidDraftSuccess: Draft parcel entry voided. Review the batch totals before finalizing.
parcelVoidForbidden: You do not have permission to void this parcel entry.
parcelVoidConflict: This parcel has linked work or financial activity that prevents an automatic void. Review its history and reconcile the related entries.
parcelVoidError: Could not void this parcel entry. Check the connection and retry.
feeIncludedInOsCredit: Delivery fee included in OS credit
codCannotExceedOriginal: Collected COD cannot exceed the original amount.
